messages.content:
Hi there! I'm so excited to be working with you on the PetCare TeleVet project. I've heard that you're looking to build a 24/7 tele-health mobile consultation platform that connects dog and cat owners with licensed veterinarians via video. That sounds like a game-changer for pet owners who can't get in to see their vet in person.

I'll be working closely with you to turn your idea into a clear, testable plan that the rest of the team can build from. To get started, I just need to ask a few questions to make sure I understand your vision correctly. Mind if I ask a few questions to get started?
